caption:
A lead calls back three days after filling out your quiz.

Whoever answers has no idea who they are, what they asked for, or what page sent them in. The customer repeats the whole story. That pause is where deals go cold.

The Black Arrow platform keeps one record per contact: quiz answers, ad clicked, every text and email threaded together. Whoever picks up sees the full history before they say hello.

Try it on your own leads. 14 days free, no card needed.
